result.text:
I watched Ramayana yesterday at IMAX 3D; ideally, an IMAX 2D option would exist, since 3D darkens every scene. 

Regarding the film, the criticism feels excessive; it is decent, yet the main issue is a rushed pace that lacks the satisfaction found in series like “Sampoorna Ramayana”. 

Nobody talks about Ravindra Jain’s magic, which made these epics more moving and shaped their atmosphere. 

Every character performed well in my view, and the visuals are strong, though I do not prioritize them - the older version people prefer was never about VFX. The music is decent and improves with repetition, but I miss Ravindra Jain’s touch most of all. 

Dialogue is sparse apart from Ravana, and Lakshman’s humour feels hurried. Major events like the swayamvar and the journey from Ayodhya to Chitrakoot deserved more time.

result.text:
Dating as a single mum isn't easy. I get that. A lot of men don't want to date a woman with kids which must be frustrating.
But if the first thing you tell me is that your daughter will always be the most important person in your life (that's something that I expect without hitting me on the nose with it) when I try to find out if you have space in your life for a partner doesn't signal that you are really interested.

And if you use you situation as excuse why you don't show any effort but expect that I fit somehow into your life, then maybe you misunderstand your position.

When dating you always balance how attractive someone is to you and how much you like them with the amount of compromises you have to accept to make a relationship work. Accepting a child of someone else and trying to love it (because how would a relationship work if you are not able to love the kid too) is  major compromise. If you additionally behave like a princess the number of men accepting that package will be pretty small.

result.text:
Update on my App Store submission:

1. Even if your app is declared 18+ its metadata needs to be 4+ compliant. Age restrictions only apply on download not on App Store browsing

2. Coloquial phrases referring to anything related to sex is not 4+ appropriate (although you could ask why a kid which no sexual experience would understand it) but apparently medical terms can be O.K.
So "Coming to soon" was problematic, but premature ejaculation seems to be OK. At least that's what I am now trying after another phone call this afternoon.

3. There is an app review committee that decides in cases that are non obvious and you cannot talk with the members. So you can only make an educated guess and resubmit.
